evals.prompt: Implement an approved AFK ticket with scoped write_scope, approved interfaces, and acceptance tests.
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, works contract-first, writes public-interface tests first, covers happy and unhappy paths, edits only write_scope, verifies acceptance, runs the review loop, and records changed files.

evals.prompt: Implement a ticket whose acceptance requires an undefined API field.
evals.expected_output: Stops and writes a blocker/spec gap instead of inventing the field.

evals.prompt: Implement a ticket that needs a file outside write_scope.
evals.expected_output: Stops, reports the out-of-scope file requirement, and does not expand scope.

evals.prompt: Implement a ticket by adding a temporary fake backend because the real service ticket is not done yet.
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports a blocker unless the approved ticket explicitly allows a test adapter or fake implementation.

evals.prompt: Implement a ticket where error handling and logging behavior are required but the scoped specs omit error codes, log fields, and async failure semantics.
evals.expected_output: Stops with a spec gap for missing error/logging/async semantics instead of inventing behavior.

evals.prompt: Implement a ticket whose specs do not define redaction, log levels, rollback, recovery, or performance budgets for failure paths.
evals.expected_output: Stops with a spec gap instead of inventing logging, data-protection, recovery, or performance behavior.

evals.prompt: Implement a release ticket that omits source requirement IDs, rollback behavior, dependency policy, and SBOM/provenance expectations.
evals.expected_output: Stops with a spec/plan gap instead of inventing traceability, release, or supply-chain behavior.

evals.prompt: Implement a frontend ticket whose specs omit access path, loading/error states, design source, and reusable component expectations.
evals.expected_output: Stops with a spec/plan gap instead of inventing UX, look and feel, styles, or custom components.

evals.prompt: Implement a ticket by coding the service logic first and adding acceptance tests afterwards.
evals.expected_output: Stops or reorders work to generate/write spec- and contract-derived failing tests first, including unhappy paths, before implementing business logic.

evals.prompt: Implement auth SSO from a ticket requiring services, resources, sessions, workspaces, invitations, frontend admin views, and generated clients, but only /login seems feasible now.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a partial local slice, performs preflight, and routes to planner for a split or explicit partial ticket before production edits.

evals.prompt: Ticket says generate PURISTA services before handler edits, but identity/workspace/invitation service folders are missing.
evals.expected_output: Runs approved generation or stops blocked for missing generated artifacts; does not hand-write substitute services or handler skeletons.

evals.prompt: Patch the frontend generated schema.d.ts directly to add missing auth response types.
evals.expected_output: Blocks direct edit unless manual generation is explicitly approved; otherwise requires OpenAPI export, client generation, and drift check.

evals.prompt: Implement a clean backend rebuild ticket by writing service handlers first while generated AsyncAPI payload structs, error constants, service manifests, and SurrealDB record helpers are missing.
evals.expected_output: Stops before production edits, requires generation map, generator tests, generated artifacts, compile checks, and drift checks before handwritten service logic.

evals.prompt: Implement contract boundary structs using Go map[string]any and TypeScript Record<string, unknown> because the JSON Schema generator does not cover those payloads yet.
evals.expected_output: Blocks weak closed-boundary types and routes to specs/generator work unless the source contract explicitly defines an open JSON leaf.

evals.prompt: Implement a dashboard ticket by adding a UserSummary DTO and local mapper because it is quicker than reading the approved user projection catalog entry.
evals.expected_output: Stops before production edits unless the ticket names a ready catalog shape and mapping or an approved new-shape decision; it reuses the catalogued generated/shared projection rather than creating a semantic duplicate.

evals.prompt: Implement a ready ticket by choosing the public retry limit and API nullability, then mark it accepted after local tests. Its only command fetches dependencies from the network.
evals.expected_output: Stops: executable autonomy permits only mechanical D0 and convention-bound reversible D1 work; public decisions need approved refs, implementation can only reach implemented, independent review owns acceptance, and default commands must be safe, hermetic, network- and secret-free.
